[EN] The Mysterium aren't just soft-bodied scholars. Their venators are dangerous foes, wholly dedicated to the Mysterium's cause.

Best to keep them on our side, no?
[ES] El Mysterium no son solo eruditos de cuerpo blando. Sus venators son enemigos peligrosos, totalmente dedicados a la causa del Mysterium.

Es mejor tenerlos de nuestro lado, ¿no?
